notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce a major update to the game!
Total rework of scientist outpost.
New questline, enemy, and NPC.
Numerous systems have been revamped.
A lot of bugs have been fixed.
Added various in-game flavor elements.


Patch Notes for the Latest Build:

Sanity Changes:

Being in the dark now has a chance to decrease your sanity.
Removed reverse look controls.
Reduced sanity damage from enemies.

Weapon Changes:

You can now reload weapons using bullet boxes instead of magazines.
New weapons added: Uzi, Sten, MG42, and laser artifact.
Updated item spawn mechanics.

Poolrooms Outpost:

Henry can duplicate owned cards.
Updated Trader.
Added additional NPCs and player rooms/hideouts.
The game now starts in the poolrooms.

Level Fun:

Multiple partygoers added..
Advancing the quest with Jenny/Alice now possible by dropping a plushie obtained from partygoers by making a cake.

Asylumrooms:

Collider and door fixes.
Added card spawn and asylumrooms questline along with new scientist - Jeremy.
Introduced asylum enemies.

Boss Changes:

Different cards from various biomes required to confront the boss.
Boss enters a second stage once below 50% HP.

Quests Changes:

New asylumroom questline.
Completion of the kinderrooms questline.

Other Changes:

Henry can craft another card of the same type if shown a card and you possess 10 cigarettes.
Added achievements.
Implemented a new realistic lighting system with baked realtime global illumination and flashlight support for navigating darkroom zones.
Various UI adjustments.
Fixed camera glitches.
Improved hit effects.
Optimized weapon muzzle flash.
Fixed item spawn issues in multiplayer.
Corrected weapon positions.
Increased single item spawns in zones.
Added posters explaining entities in the game world.
Skills are retained after death.

notes.title: 🚀 Backrooms Cycle Early Access Release 🚀
notes.notes:
Attention, brave explorers! The day has finally arrived. Backrooms Cycle is officially launching into Early Access, and we couldn't be more excited to share this incredible adventure with you!

First and foremost, Brace yourselves for a truly immersive experience like no other. With our groundbreaking procedural world generation, every journey into the enigmatic Yellowrooms will be a unique and thrilling encounter. Expect the unexpected as you navigate through ever-changing corridors, each filled with its own secrets and challenges.

Prepare for an unparalleled level of immersion as you engage in captivating dialogues and embark on exciting quests. Dive deep into a rich narrative that will keep you hooked from start to finish. Explore the depths of the Backrooms, encounter enigmatic characters, and make choices that shape your destiny in this unforgiving realm.

But that's not all—get ready for heart-pounding combat and epic boss fights that will test your skills and determination. Arm yourself with an extensive arsenal of items and utilize our tetris inventory system to strategically manage your resources. Break through walls to uncover hidden paths and unveil the secrets that lie beyond.

And the excitement doesn't stop there. Backrooms Cycle offers a multiplayer experience like no other, with no player limit. Join forces with friends and fellow adventurers as you conquer the darkness together. Cooperation and teamwork will be key to survival in this ever-shifting labyrinth.

However, we want to emphasize that Backrooms Cycle is launching in Early Access for a reason. We need your help, your opinions, and your testing expertise to shape this game into its full potential. We're committed to working closely with the community, listening to your feedback, and implementing new content and features based on your suggestions.

This journey is just beginning, and we invite you to join us on this remarkable expedition. As we venture through Early Access, we encourage you to reach out to us on Discord or engage in lively discussions on the Steam forums. Your input will play a vital role in making Backrooms Cycle the best it can be.

We want to express our deepest gratitude to all those who have supported us thus far. Your enthusiasm and passion have been our driving force, and we can't wait to continue this journey with you by our side.

So, grab your flashlight, steel your nerves, and prepare to immerse yourself in the world of Backrooms Cycle. Together, let's unravel the mysteries of the Backrooms and forge our path through this captivating realm.

Thank you for joining us on this incredible adventure!

The Backrooms Cycle Development Team
